results.rationale: Consistency: sky, horizon and distant road remain, but the field vegetation changes to a conspicuously outlined texture. Instruction: long strings of small prayer flags are added across the flatland as requested. Knowledge: several traditional colors are visible at the left, though the long central run is predominantly pale rather than clearly five-colored. Quality: recognizable landscape and flag strings, with a noticeable wormlike/repetitive texture across the grass.

Consistency: the supplied source actually shows a diagonal black-and-gold pen, which is retained in the same orientation and appearance; background replacement is requested. Instruction: a right-positioned bear balloon, colorful Bear Balloon Party title, stars, candies and blue/cloud background are present, but the bear is cropped at the bottom and is newly added rather than derived from a source bear. Quality: clear lettering, coherent glossy bear and clean decorative shapes.
